leaf retention, obstruction, emergency release, platform gap
belt force, end stop, vibration, manual release

release_holds: Measure bogie/body mating datums, force transfer, fasteners, suspension sweep and lifting access.
Measure both door apertures and control guide, pulley, belt, stop, retention, release, interlock and wiring interfaces.
Verify full 3D door motion and 150 mm proposed tool sweep; 30 mm ideal guide-end stock is not a tolerance budget.
Locate and weigh 10,090.2 kg/car residual account, resolve service-pack overlap and measure whole-car mass, CG and inertia.
Fit HVAC, battery, brake, wiring, cooling, coupling and repair access on one physical candidate.
Approve material/process specifications, joint allowables, QA limits and supplier drawings before prototype fabrication.

selected_assembly_operations.operation: Cut and fixture aluminium sills, bows and bogie hardpoints
Join frame and verify diagonal, twist and load-path datums
Prepare, bond and retain GFRP panels and roof/floor sandwiches
Fit doors, glazing, seating, accessible zones and flush PV
Manufacture or procure identical unpowered bogies; inspect wheelsets, bearings and welds
Install independent brakes, WSP, parking and odometry
Fit passive LIM fin and hangers; verify hot and suspension-travel clearance
Install independently fused service/essential supply, HVAC and low-voltage equipment
Weigh equipped car and measure CG/inertia; perform structural, insulation, brake and interface tests
